text: {"assertions":["A lock timeout issue was discovered in storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql on March 1, 2026.","The lock timeout only appeared on the staging read replica, not in other environments.","The lock timeout can be reproduced by running the migration against a loaded table.","The root cause was a race condition in lazy initialization.","The lock timeout triggered a statement timeout that was not caught by alerts.","The monitoring alert for this issue remained silent for 73 consecutive days.","The fix implements a double-checked lock pattern to guard the initialization.","The fix was submitted in PR #2706 on the branch fix/lock-timeout-1."]}
